scenario: Vulnerable Cronjob Configurations - Cronjob Wildcard Injection
data_flow: fixturefiles creates/renames inbox filename -> CrOniE invokes the root cron.d shell command -> bare * expands in the inbox cwd -> option branch in fixture-maintenance.c -> predefined stdout diagnostic
limitations: The helper only parses glob-expanded argument strings and itself writes no files. CWE-78 and CWE-269 describe the modeled command/privilege boundary; no command execution or privilege escalation is implemented. File contents are never read.
